source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 22ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Όσιος Βαραδάτος»

attestations.note: The page has him of Alexandria and drawn out of the desert by Theodotus, patriarch of Antioch, whose years it gives as 418 to 427, for the church's charitable work; it ends him asleep on one of his tours and gives no year for his death and no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).

floruit.note: saint.gr: «όταν ο Πατριάρχης Αντιοχείας Θεόδοτος (418 - 427 μ.Χ.), πληροφορήθηκε για τις σπάνιες αρετές του Βαραδάτη». The interval is the patriarchate the page prints; the page gives no year of birth or of death.
